Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 18 · NFL Week 6 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 18, 3:20 PM ET

Dak Prescott has the highest SPAGS projection in the Cowboys at Packers DraftKings Showdown: 20.7 points at $10,400 FLEX, 31.1 at captain for $15,600. Across 10,000 simulations Prescott holds 63% of the winning-lineup credit. Jordan Love holds the most, at 66%. The case against Prescott is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.5 points at a $10,400 FLEX salary, in a game with a 53.5-point total.

Jordan Love has the largest captain share: 13.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Love at captain. Dak Prescott is the next captain in line, at 13.1%.

Green Bay is a 1.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 27.5 for the Packers and 26 for the Cowboys.

Behind Prescott and Love, the next projections are CeeDee Lamb (18.4, $10,800), Javonte Williams (17.8, $9,600) and Christian Watson (16.6, $9,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 18, 3:20 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jordan Love, GB QB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Jordan Love holds 13.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 20.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Love averaged 20.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.9 and a ceiling of 39.4. He holds 66% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.2% as the captain and 52.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Dak Prescott, DAL QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Dak Prescott holds 13.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 20.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Prescott averaged 20.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.5 and a ceiling of 39.7. He holds 63% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.1% as the captain and 50.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Javonte Williams, DAL RB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Javonte Williams holds 11.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,400 and the 17.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.3 carries and 3.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 33.7. He holds 50% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.7% as the captain and 38.8% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Cowboys vs Packers

CeeDee Lamb, DAL WR ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 18.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 40.8. He holds 45% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.3% as the captain and 33.6% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Watson averaged 16.5 points with a simulated floor of 4.3 and a ceiling of 38.5. Across 10,000 simulations Smack averaged 10.1 points with a simulated floor of 4.5 and a ceiling of 17.3. He holds 35% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.1% as the captain and 33.6% in a FLEX spot.

Ryan Flournoy projects for 8.9 DraftKings points at a $4,400 FLEX salary, 2.02 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 5.1 targets on 30.5 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Flournoy averaged 8.9 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 21.1. Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown?

Jordan Love holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 13.2%, ahead of Dak Prescott (13.1%) and Javonte Williams (11.7%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Cowboys vs Packers?

Build around Matthew Golden at captain with Dak Prescott, Jordan Love and George Pickens at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (18 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,400 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown?

Dak Prescott leads the SPAGS model at 20.7 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 31.1 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Cowboys vs Packers Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb is the most expensive player at $10,800 FLEX and $16,200 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Trey Smack (10.0 points at $4,800), Ryan Flournoy (8.9 points at $4,400) and Packers (4.9 points at $4,000).

What is the Cowboys vs Packers spread and total?

The Packers are a 1.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 53.5, with implied team totals of 27.5 for the Packers and 26 for the Cowboys.
